assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE standalone 2D game VFX sprite on genuine transparent alpha for Half-Life Resonance. Use the attached original Half-Life: Alyx retail scene only as the visual identity reference. The reference shows a FREE Reviver in the elevator cage on the left, with visible blue electrical arcs around it; it is not a possessed zombie. Isolate and redraw ONE of the narrow cyan-white jagged electrical filaments visible below the free creature, between approximately image coordinates x550,y540 and x660,y690. This single environmental discharge filament is the whole asset. Keep a thin white-blue luminous core, irregular angular bends and a restrained soft cyan halo, with at most the small branching visible in that filament. Give the filament a slightly descending diagonal orientation and generous clear padding. Preserve the reference's modest thickness and blue palette; no invented lightning sphere, projectile body, impact explosion, circular aura or extra bolts. No creature, hands, host, elevator, grille, room, floor, target, HUD, text, frame or watermark. One static instant only, not a sprite sheet or multiple phases. The PNG is an isolated candidate environmental electrical arc, not a depiction or certification of a directed combat attack.

visual_qa.notes: Un filament cyan-blanc avec petite branche, sans créature ni décor; lisible sur les deux fonds. Halo doux semi-transparent. Sept pixels du bord à alpha 1, aucun à alpha ≥16; originaux conservés sans retouche. Forme reconstruite, non certifiée 1:1.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE standalone 2D game VFX sprite with genuine transparent alpha, for Half-Life Resonance. The attached bitmap is a firsthand Half-Life 2 PC retail gameplay capture published in 2008. It visibly shows the original pistol firing. Reconstruct ONLY the compact muzzle flash visible immediately ahead of the pistol, around x140,y90 of that 256x170 reference. One short irregular pale white-yellow center with a few softly shaped amber-orange lobes and a restrained orange translucent glow, matching the modest warm flash seen in the original. Keep the source's slightly diagonal emission direction from lower right toward upper left; center the isolated flash with ample empty space. It must be a single compact flash, not a long flame or energy beam. Use smooth hand-painted high-definition edges while keeping the simple source shape; no elaborate invented sparks, debris, dramatic blast, impact mark or smoke plume. Remove all weapon, hand, room, wall, floor, HUD, captions, logos and watermark. No bullets, bullet bodies, tracers or travel trail. One static instant only, no animation sheet, storyboard, comparisons or multiple effects. Deliver one original transparent PNG candidate.

visual_qa.notes: Un flash compact blanc-jaune/orange, sans arme, décor ou traceur; lisible sur les deux fonds. Halo diffus et texture plus détaillée que la petite source : précision géométrique non établie. 176 pixels du bord à alpha 1, aucun à alpha ≥16; originaux conservés sans retouche. Le volume ne certifie pas un rendu muzzle exact du jeu.

assets.save_method: Original built-in imagegen bytes preserved; GitHub blob hash verified before local PNG copy.
